title: Astricon 2020
html:
Like most of the events this year, Astricon 2020 (the Asterisk users conference) takes place online, being code-named Astricon Plan (9), during October 21-22. More details can be found at:

  • https://www.asterisk.org/community/astricon-user-conference/

Fred Posner has a presentation about Scaling With Kamailio on the second day at 2:00pm CDT, a few more details about the talk being available on the schedule:

  • https://www.asterisk.org/community/astricon-user-conference/schedule/

All the talks can be watched live online on event’s web site. Enjoy the event!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
